latestVersion.changelog:
Video Editor Link 1.0.0 — initial release

- Instantly edit and share videos by uploading clips and describing desired edits.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM uploads up to 500MB.
- Automatic connection setup with free credits for new users; no manual tokens needed.
- Exports 1080p MP4 videos via a shareable download link in under 90 seconds.
- Built for content creators seeking fast, no-fuss video editing—no complex software required.
